description: Use when the user wants to create multiple study cards at once (2–50 notes). Prefer this over repeated anki_create_note calls. Returns per-note success and error details. Safety: ask the user to confirm before creating a large batch of notes.

allowDuplicate.description: Allow duplicate notes in their target decks.

deck.description: Target deck name. The deck is created if it does not exist.

fields.description: Note fields keyed by exact model field names. For Basic: {Front: 'question', Back: 'answer'}.

tags.description: Optional tags for organization. Use strings without spaces for best Anki compatibility.

type.description: Note type/model name. Common: Basic, Cloze.

stopOnError.description: Stop after the first failed note.

name: anki_batch_create_notes
title: Batch Create Anki Notes
